en: Called when a loot table of an inventory is generated in the world.
For example, when opening a shipwreck chest.

en: Called when a brewing stand starts brewing.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on brewing start

en: Called whenever a player chats.
Use chat format to change message format.
Use chat recipients to edit chat recipients.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on chat

en: Called whenever an entity enters a state of being in love.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on love mode enter

An entity hooked event is triggered when an entity gets caught by a fishing rod.
A fish escape event is called when the player fails to click on time, and the fish escapes.
A fish approaching event is when the bobber is waiting to be hooked, and a fish is approaching.
A fishing state change event is triggered whenever the fishing state changes.

en: Called when a bell resonates, highlighting nearby raiders.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bell resonate

en: Called when a piston is about to extend.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on piston extend

en: Called when a player puts an item into enchantment table. This event may be called multiple times.
To get the enchant item, see the enchant item expression
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on enchant prepare

en: Called when a player leaves the server.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on quit

en: Called when a player enters a world. Does not work with other entities!
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player world change

en: Called when a portal is created, either by a player or mob lighting an obsidian frame on fire, or by a nether portal creating its teleportation target in the nether/overworld.
In Minecraft 1.14+, you can use the player in this event.
Please note that there may not always be a player (or other entity) in this event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on portal create

en: Called when an inventory (a hopper, a hopper minecart, etc.) picks up an item
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory pickup

en: Called whenever experience is about to spawn.
Please note that this event will not fire for xp orbs spawned by plugins (including Skript) with Bukkit.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on experience spawn

en: Called when a slime splits. Usually this happens when a big slime dies.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on slime split

en: Called when a player leaves a bed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bed leave

en: Called when a player has traded with a villager.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player trade

en: Called after a new chunk was generated.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on chunk generate

description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on server start/stop

en: Called when an entity toggles glider on or off, or when server toggles gliding state of an entity forcibly.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on gliding state change

description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player chunk enter

en: Called when a slot in a player's inventory is changed.
Warning: setting the event-slot to a new item can result in an infinite loop.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory slot change

en: Called when a player picks up an arrow from the ground.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player pickup arrow

en: Called when a player starts or stops sprinting. Use is sprinting to get whether the player was sprinting before the event was called.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on sprint toggle

en: Called when an entity dies, always. If they are not holding a totem, this is cancelled - you can, however, uncancel it.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on resurrect attempt

en: Called when a player or an entity uses a nether or end portal. Note that 'on entity portal' event does not apply to players.
Cancel the event to prevent the entity from teleporting.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on portal

en: Called when sheep regrows its sheared wool back.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on sheep regrow wool

Works also when one or both of the slots are empty.
The event is called before the items are actually swapped,
so when you use the player's tool or player's offtool expressions,
they will return the values before the swap -
this enables you to cancel the event before anything happens.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on hand item swap

en: Called when a player's experience cooldown changes.
Experience cooldown is how long until a player can pick up another orb of experience.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on experience cooldown change

en: Called when an entity jumps.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity jump

en: Called when a player's experience changes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on experience change

en: Called when a vault in a trial chamber is about to display an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vault display item

en: Called when a player starts sleeping.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bed enter

en: Called when a vehicle moves.
Please note that using this event can cause lag if there are multiple vehicle entities, i.e. Horse, Pig, Boat, Minecart
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle move

en: Called when an anvil is damaged/broken from being used to repair/rename items.
Note: this does not include anvil damage from falling.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on anvil damage

en: Called when the spawn point of a world changes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on spawn change

en: Called when a piston is about to retract.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on piston retract

en: Called when a bell is rung.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bell ring

en: Called when the server sends a list of commands to the player. This usually happens on join. The sent commands can be modified via the sent commands expression.
Modifications will affect what commands show up for the player to tab complete. They will not affect what commands the player can actually run.
Adding new commands to the list is illegal behavior and will be ignored.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on send command list

en: Called when a block starts burning, i.e. a fire block is placed next to it and this block is flammable.
The burn event will be called when the block is about do be destroyed by the fire.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on ignition

en: Called when a player's level changes, e.g. by gathering experience or by enchanting something.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on level change

en: Called when an inventory is opened for player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory open

en: Called when a server list ping is coming in, generally when a Minecraft client pings the server to show its information in the server list.
The IP expression can be used to get the IP adress of the pinger.
This event can be cancelled on PaperSpigot 1.12.2+ only and this means the player will see the server as offline (but still can join).

Also you can use MOTD, Max Players, Online Players Count, Protocol Version, Version String, Hover List and Server Icon expressions, and Player Info Visibility and Hide Player from Server List effects to modify the server list.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on server list ping

en: Called when a vehicle gets damage. Too much damage will destroy the vehicle.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle damage

en: Called when an item is damaged. Most tools are damaged by using them; armor is damaged when the wearer takes damage.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item damage

en: Called when a chunk is unloaded due to not being near any player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on chunk unload

en: Called when a player empties a bucket. You can also use the place event with a check for water or lava.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bucket empty

en: Called when a player starts or stops sneaking. Use is sneaking to get whether the player was sneaking before the event was called.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on sneak toggle

en: Called when a player breaks their tool because its damage reached the maximum value.
This event cannot be cancelled.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item break

en: Called when an entity swims or stops swimming.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on swim toggle

en: Called when a leaf block decays due to not being connected to a tree.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on leaves decay

en: Called when a player fertilizes blocks.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on block fertilize

en: Called when a player throws an egg and it lands. You can just use the shoot event in most cases. However, this event allows modification of properties like the hatched entity type and the number of entities to hatch.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on egg throw

en: Called when a zombie is done breaking a wooden door. Can be cancelled to prevent the zombie from breaking the door.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on zombie break door

en: Called directly after the trigger is loaded, or directly before the whole script is unloaded.
The keyword 'async' indicates the trigger can be ran asynchronously,
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on script load/unload

en: Called when a pig is stroke by lightning and transformed into a zombie pigman. Cancel the event to prevent the transformation.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on pig zap

en: Called when the player connects to the server. This event is called before the player actually joins the server, so if you want to prevent players from joining you should prefer this event over on join.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on connect

en: Called after a player changed their language in the game settings. You can use the language expression to get the current language of the player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on language change

en: Called whenever a projectile is shot. Use the shooter expression to get who shot the projectile.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on shoot

en: Called when a physics check is done on a block. By cancelling this event you can prevent some things from happening, e.g. sand falling, dirt turning into grass, torches dropping if their supporting block is destroyed, etc.Please note that using this event might cause quite some lag since it gets called extremely often.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on physics

en: Called when a player drags an item in their cursor across the inventory.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory drag

en: Called when a player rightclicks on a block while holding a block or a placeable item. You can either cancel the event to prevent the block from being built, or uncancel it to allow it.
Please note that the data value of the block to be placed is not available in this event, only its ID.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on can build check

en: Called when a moving world border has finished its move.
This event does not get called for virtual borders.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world border bounds finish change

en: Called when a player stops using an item. For example, when the player releases the interact button when holding a bow, an edible item, or a spyglass.
Note that event-timespan will return the time the item was used for.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on stop using item

en: Called when a player respawns via death or entering the end portal in the end. You should prefer this event over the death event as the player is technically alive when this event is called.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on respawn

en: Called when a player starts to break a block. You can usually just use the leftclick event for this.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on block damage

en: Called when lightning strikes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on lightning strike

en: Called when an entity (a primed TNT or a creeper) explodes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on explode

en: Called when a new vehicle is created, e.g. when a player places a boat or minecart.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle create

en: Called when a creeper is struck by lighting and gets powered. Cancel the event to prevent the creeper from being powered.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on creeper power

en: Called when player's currently viewed inventory is closed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory close

en: Called when a mob starts/stops following/attacking another entity, usually a player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on target

en: Called when a player fills a bucket.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bucket fill

When this event is called, the initiator may have already removed the item from the source inventory and is ready to move it into the destination inventory.
If this event is cancelled, the items will be returned to the source inventory.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on inventory item move

en: Called when a message is broadcasted.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on broadcast

en: Called when a player is kicked from the server. You can change the kick message or cancel the event entirely.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on kick

en: Called when a horse jumps.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on horse jump

en: Called when a blocks flows or teleports to another block. This not only applies to water and lava, but teleporting dragon eggs as well.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on flow

en: Called when a beacon is activated or deactivated.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on beacon toggle

en: Called when a player successfully enchants an item.
To get the enchanted item, see the enchant item expression
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on enchant

Cancelling will prevent piglins from dropping items, but will still make them pick up the input.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on piglin barter

en: Called when a player uses a firework to boost their fly speed when flying with an elytra.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on elytra boost

en: Called when an entity dismounts.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity dismount

en: Called when the redstone current of a block changes. This event is of not much use yet.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on redstone

en: Called when a player has an item repaired via the Mending enchantment.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item mend

en: Called when a projectile collides with an entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on projectile collide

en: Called when a world border's center has changed.
This event does not get called for virtual borders.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world border center change

en: Called when a world border changes its bounds, either over time, or instantly.
This event does not get called for virtual borders.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world border bounds change

en: Called when a chunk loads. The chunk might or might not contain mobs when it's loaded.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on chunk load

en: Called when an explosive is primed, i.e. an entity will explode shortly. Creepers can abort the explosion if the player gets too far away, while TNT will explode for sure after a short time.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on explosion prime

en: Called when an entity exits a vehicle.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle exit

en: Called when a villager changes its career. Can be caused by being employed or losing their job.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on villager career change

en: Called when a player joins the server for the first time.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on first join

en: Called when area effect cloud applies its potion effect. This happens every 5 ticks by default.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on aoe cloud effect

en: Called whenever a player jumps.
This event requires PaperSpigot.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on jump

Cancelling this event will skip the current arrow item and fire a new event for the next arrow item.
The arrow and bow in the event can be accessed with the Readied Arrow/Bow expression.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on ready arrow

en: Called when a player tames a wolf or ocelot. Can be cancelled to prevent the entity from being tamed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on tame

en: Called whenever a player changes their held item by selecting a different slot (e.g. the keys 1-9 or the mouse wheel), not by dropping or replacing the item in the current slot.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on tool change

en: Called when a bat attempts to go to sleep or wakes up.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on bat toggle sleep

en: Called when an entity enters a nether portal or an end portal. Please note that this event will be fired many times for a nether portal.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on portal enter

en: Called when a sponge absorbs blocks.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on sponge absorb

en: Called when entity starts riding another.

description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on spread

en: As signs are placed empty, this event is called when a player is done editing a sign.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on sign change

en: Called when the player activates the riptide enchantment, using their trident to propel them through the air.
Note: the riptide action is performed client side, so manipulating the player in this event may have undesired effects.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on riptide

en: Called when the player joins the server. The player is already in a world when this event is called, so if you want to prevent players from joining you should prefer on connect over this event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on join

en: Called when a player has slept long enough to count as passing the night/storm.
Cancelling this event will prevent the player from being counted as deeply sleeping unless they exit and re-enter the bed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player deep sleep

en: Called when a player edits a book.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on book edit

en: Called when an item is put in a slot for repair by an anvil. Please note that this event is called multiple times in a single item slot move.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on anvil prepare

en: Called when a player steps on a pressure plate or tripwire respectively.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on pressure plate / trip

en: Called when a vehicle is destroyed. Any passenger will be ejected and the vehicle might drop some item(s).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle destroy

en: Called when an enderman gets mad because a player looked at them.
Note: This does not stop enderman from targeting the player as a result of getting damaged.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on enderman enrage

en: Called when a projectile hits an entity or a block.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on projectile hit

en: Called when a players stops/starts flying.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on flight toggle

en: Called when an entity is set on fire, e.g. by fire or lava, a fireball, or by standing in direct sunlight (zombies, skeletons).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on combust

en: Called when a player swings their arm.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on arm swing

en: Called when a player changes the effects of a beacon.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on beacon change effect

en: Called when an entity enters a vehicle, either deliberately (players) or by falling into them (mobs).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle enter

en: Called when a player signs a book.

en: Called when the hunger bar of a player changes, i.e. either increases by eating or decreases over time.

description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on brewing fuel

en: Called whenever two animals begin to conceive a child. The type can be specified.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity breed

en: Called when a furnace starts smelting an item in its ore slot.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on start smelt

en: Called when a player takes any item out of the furnace.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on furnace item extract

event-block represents the old block and event-blockdata represents the new replacement that'll be applied to the block.

en: Called when a living entity (including players) dies.

en: Called when a player gets an effect from a beacon.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on beacon effect

en: Called when a player enters a command (not necessarily a Skript command) but you can check if command is a skript command, see Is a Skript command condition.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on command

en: Called when a player selects a recipe in a stonecutter.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on stonecutter recipe select

en: Called when an item is about to be despawned from the world, usually 5 minutes after it was dropped.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item despawn

en: This event can be used to listen to teleports from non-players or player entities respectively.
When teleporting entities, the event may also be called due to a result of natural causes, such as an enderman or shulker teleporting, or wolves teleporting to players.
When teleporting players, the event can be called by teleporting through a nether/end portal, or by other means (e.g. plugins).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on teleport

en: Called when a player drops an item from their inventory, or an entity drops an item, such as a chicken laying an egg.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on drop

en: Called when an entity spawns (excluding players).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on spawn

en: Called when a player enters or leaves a region.
This event requires a supported regions plugin to be installed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on region enter/leave

en: Called when a world is loaded. As with the world init event, this event will not be called for the server's default world(s).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world load

en: Called when a block broken by a player drops something.
<ul>
• event-player: The player that broke the block
• past event-block: The block that was broken
• event-block: The block after being broken
• event-items (or drops): The drops of the block
• event-entities: The entities of the dropped items
If the breaking of the block leads to others being broken, such as torches, they will appearin "event-items" and "event-entities".
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on block drop

en: Called when a player/entity picks up an item. Please note that the item is still on the ground when this event is called.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on pick up

en: Called when a world is initialized. As all default worlds are initialized before
any scripts are loaded, this event is only called for newly created worlds.
World management plugins might change the behaviour of this event though.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world init

en: Called when a player crafts an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on craft

en: Called when a player moves onto a certain type of block.
Please note that using this event can cause lag if there are many players online.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on move on

en: Called when a vehicle collides with a block or entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on vehicle collision

en: Called when an entity is leashed or unleashed. Cancelling these events will prevent the leashing or unleashing from occurring.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on leash / unleash

en: Called when a furnace burns an item from its fuel slot.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on fuel burn

en: Called when a player takes action on a resource pack request sent via the
send resource pack effect.
The resource pack condition can be used
to check the resource pack state.
This event will be triggered once when the player accepts or declines the resource pack request,
and once when the resource pack is successfully installed or failed to download.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on resource pack request response

en: Called when a player places a block.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on place

en: Called when a world is unloaded. This event will never be called if you don't have a world management plugin.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world unload

en: Called when a crop grows. Alternative to new form of generic grow event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on block growth

en:
Called when a player attempts to attack an entity.
The event will be cancelled as soon as it is fired for non-living entities.
Cancelling this event will prevent the attack and any sounds from being played when attacking.
Any damage events will not be called if this is cancelled.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on attempt attack

en: An event that is called periodically.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: periodical

en: Called when a world's weather changes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on weather change

en: Called when the local time of the system the server is running on reaches the provided real-life time.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on system time

en: Called when armor pieces of a player are changed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on armor change

en: Called when a player picks an item, block or an entity using the pick block key (default middle mouse button).
The past event-slot represents the slot containing the item that will be put into the players hotbar, or nothing, if the item is not in the inventory.
The event-slot represents the slot in the hotbar where the picked item will be placed.
Both event-slots may be set to new slots.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on player pick item

en: Called when dropped items merge into a single stack. event-entity will be the entity which is trying to merge, and future event-entity will be the entity which is being merged into.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item merge

en:
Called when an entity shoots a bow.
event-entity refers to the shot projectile/entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity shoot bow

en: Called when a world is saved to disk. Usually all worlds are saved simultaneously, but world management plugins could change this.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on world save

en: Called when a firework explodes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on firework explode

en: Called whenever an item stack is spawned in a world, e.g. as drop of a block or mob, a player throwing items out of their inventory, or a dispenser dispensing an item (not shooting it).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on item spawn

en: Called when a player's gamemode changes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on gamemode change

en: Called when a dispenser dispenses an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on dispense

en: Called when a block is destroyed by fire.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on burn

en: Called with a player starts, stops or swaps spectating an entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on spectate

en: Called when a block is created, but not by a player, e.g. snow forms due to snowfall, water freezes in cold biomes. This isn't called when block spreads (mushroom growth, water physics etc.), as it has its own event (see spread event).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on form

en: Called when a block is broken by a player. If you use 'on mine', only events where the broken block dropped something will call the trigger.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on break / mine

en: Called when a block 'fades away', e.g. ice or snow melts.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on fade

en: Called when an entity receives damage, e.g. by an attack from another entity, lava, fire, drowning, fall, suffocation, etc.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on damage

en: An event that occurs at a given minecraft time in every world or only in specific worlds.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: at time

en: Called when a user clicks on a block, an entity or air with or without an item in their hand.
Please note that rightclick events with an empty hand while not looking at a block are not sent to the server, so there's no way to detect them.
Also note that a leftclick on an entity is an attack and thus not covered by the 'click' event, but the 'damage' event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on click

en: Called when an entity is about to be replaced by another entity.

Examples when it's called include; when a zombie gets cured and a villager spawns, an entity drowns in water like a zombie that turns to a drown, an entity that gets frozen in powder snow, a mooshroom that when sheared, spawns a new cow.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity transform

en: Called when an entity is healed, e.g. by eating (players), being fed (pets), or by the effect of a potion of healing (overworld mobs) or harm (nether mobs).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on heal

on entity potion effect.name: on entity potion effect
patterns: entity potion effect [modif[y|ication]] [[of] %potion effect types%] [%potion actions%] [due to %potion causes%]

en: Called when an entity's potion effect is modified.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on entity potion effect

on grow.name: on grow
patterns: grow[th] from %item types/block datas% [in]to (%tree types%|%item types/block datas%)

en: Called when a tree, giant mushroom or plant grows to next stage.
"of" matches any grow event, "from" matches only the old state, "into" matches only the new state,and "from into" requires matching both the old and new states.
Using "and" lists in this event is equivalent to using "or" lists. The event will trigger if any one of the elements is what grew.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: on grow

en:
Checks if the 'brewing fuel' event will consume fuel.
Preventing the fuel from being consumed will keep the fuel item and still add to the fuel level of the brewing stand.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: brewing will consume fuel

en: Checks if the lure enchantment is applied to the current fishing event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: fishing lure applied

en: Checks whether the leash item will drop during the leash detaching in an unleash event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: leash will drop

en: Checks to see if the firework used in an 'elytra boost' event will be consumed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: will consume boosting firework

en: Whether the egg will hatch in a Player Egg Throw event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: egg will hatch

en: Checks whether or not the event is cancelled.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: event cancelled

en: Checks what the respawn location of a player in the respawn event is.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is bed/anchor spawn

en: Check if the current script, or another script, is currently loaded.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is script loaded

equippable component - will lose durabil.name: equippable component - will lose durability
patterns: %equippable components% will (lose durability|be damaged) (on [wearer['s]] injury|when [[the] wearer [is]] (hurt|injured|damaged))
%equippable components% (will not|won't) (lose durability|be damaged) (on [wearer['s]] injury|when [[the] wearer [is]] (hurt|injured|damaged))

en:
Whether an item will be damaged when the wearer gets injured.
NOTE: Equippable component elements are experimental. Thus, they are subject to change and may not work as intended.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: equippable component - will lose durability

en: Checks whether a given expression or variable is set.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: exists/is set

en: Checks if a block is indirectly or directly powered by redstone
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is block redstone powered

en: Check if a plugin is enabled/disabled on the server.
Plugin names can be found in the plugin's 'plugin.yml' file or by using the '/plugins' command, they are NOT the name of the plugin's jar file.
When checking if a plugin is not enabled, this will return true if the plugin is either disabled or not on the server.
When checking if a plugin is disabled, this will return true if the plugin is on the server and is disabled.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is plugin enabled

is custom name visible.name: is custom name visible
patterns: custom name of %entities% (isn't|is not|are not|aren't) visible

en: Checks if an entity's custom name is visible.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is custom name visible

en: Checks whether a player or IP is banned.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is banned

en: Checks whether a player can see specific message types in chat.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: can see messages

damage source - does scale with difficul.name: damage source - does scale with difficulty
patterns: %damage sources% (do not|don't|does not|doesn't) scale damage with difficulty
%damage sources%'[s] damage (do not|don't|does not|doesn't) scale with difficulty

en: Whether the damage from a damage source scales with the difficulty of the server.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: damage source - does scale with difficulty

en: Whether or not the server or a player is whitelisted, or the server is whitelist enforced.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is whitelisted

en: Checks whether or not respawn anchors work in a world.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: do respawn anchors work

is hand raised.name: is hand raised
patterns: [main] hand[s] of %living entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) raised
off[ |-]hand[s] of %living entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) raised

en: Checks whether an entity has one or both of their hands raised.
Hands are raised when an entity is using an item (eg: blocking, drawing a bow, eating).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is hand raised

ignition process.name: ignition process
patterns: [creeper[s]] %living entities% ((is|are)|(isn't|is not|aren't|are not)) going to explode
[creeper[s]] %living entities% ((is|are)|(isn't|is not|aren't|are not)) in the (ignition|explosion) process

en: Checks if a creeper is going to explode.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: ignition process

has played before.name: has played before
patterns: %offline players% (has not|hasn't|have not|haven't|did not|didn't) [(already|yet)] play[ed] [on (this|the) server] (before|already|yet)

en: Checks whether a player has played on this server before. You can also use on first join if you want to make triggers for new players.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has played before

en: Checks if the given string is alphanumeric.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: alphanumeric

en: Whether the damage from a damage source was indirectly caused.
Vanilla damage sources are considered indirect if the 'causing entity' and the 'direct entity' are not the same. For example, taking damage from an arrow that was shot by an entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: damage source - was indirectly caused

en: Checks if current Minecraft version is given version or newer.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: running minecraft

en: Checks if an entity was spawned from a mob spawner.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is from a mob spawner

en: Checks whether a date is in the past or future.
Note that using the 'now' expression will not be in the past or future when used directly in the condition.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: in the past/future

en: Checks state of the resource pack in a resource pack request response event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: resource pack

en: Whether the entire or additional tooltip of an item is shown or hidden.
The 'entire tooltip' is what shows to the player when they hover an item (i.e. name, lore, etc.).
The 'additional tooltip' hides certain information from certain items (potions, maps, books, fireworks, and banners).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has item tooltips

en: Set the PvP state for a given world.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: pvp

is incendiary.name: is incendiary
patterns: %entities% ((is not|are not|isn't|aren't) incendiary|(does not|do not|doesn't|don't) cause[s] a[n] (incendiary|fiery) explosion)

en: Checks if an entity will create fire when it explodes. This condition is also usable in an explosion prime event.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is incendiary

en: The damage cause of a damage event. Please click on the link for more information.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: damage cause

en:
A condition that randomly succeeds or fails.
Valid values are between 0% and 100%, or if the percent sign is omitted, between 0 and 1.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: chance

en:
Checks whether a type or list contains certain elements.
When checking if a list contains a specific element, use '{list::*} contains {x}'.
When checking if a single type contains something, use `player's inventory contains {x}`.
When checking if many types contain something, use '{inventories::*} contain {x}` or `contents of {inventories::*} contain {x}`.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: contains (property)

is holding.name: is holding
patterns: [%living entities%] (ha(s|ve) not|do[es]n't have) %item types% in [main] hand
[%living entities%] (is not|isn't) holding %item types% [in main hand]
[%living entities%] (ha(s|ve) not|do[es]n't have) %item types% in off[(-| )]hand
[%living entities%] (is not|isn't) holding %item types% in off[(-| )]hand

en: Checks whether a player is holding a specific item. Cannot be used with endermen, use 'entity is [not] an enderman holding <item type>' instead.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is holding

en: Checks whether an item is the preferred tool for a block. A preferred tool is one that will drop the block's item when used. For example, a wooden pickaxe is a preferred tool for grass and stone blocks, but not for iron ore.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is preferred tool

en: Checks whether the given players can see the provided entities.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: can see

has line of sight.name: has line of sight
patterns: %living entities% does(n't| not) have [a] [direct] line of sight to %entities/locations%
%living entities% (has|have) no [direct] line of sight to %entities/locations%

en: Checks whether living entities have an unobstructed line of sight to other entities or locations.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has line of sight

en: Checks if a player is pressing a certain input key.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is pressing key

en: Checks whether a metadata holder has a metadata tag.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has metadata

en: Checks if a text starts or ends with another.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: starts/ends with

can hold.name: can hold
patterns: %inventories% (can(no|')t hold|(ha(s|ve) not|ha(s|ve)n't|do[es]n't have) [enough] space (for|to hold)) %item types%

en: Tests whether a player or a chest can hold the given item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: can hold

en: Checks whether the defined strings match the input regexes (Regular expressions).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: matches

en: Checks whether a script is using an experimental feature by name.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is using experimental feature

en: Test whether a player has a certain permission.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has permission

has item cooldown.name: has item cooldown
patterns: %players% (doesn't|does not|do not|don't) have [([an] item|a)] cooldown (on|for) %item types%
%players% (doesn't|does not|do not|don't) have %item types% on [(item|a)] cooldown

en:
Checks whether a cooldown is active on the specified item for a specific player.
If the provided item has a cooldown group component specified, the cooldown group will take priority.
Otherwise, the cooldown of the item material will be used.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: has item cooldown

en: The time of a world.
Use the "minecraft timespan" syntax to change the time according to Minecraft's time intervals.
Since Minecraft uses discrete intervals for time (ticks), changing the time by real-world minutes or real-world seconds only changes it approximately.
Removing an amount of time from a world's time will move the clock forward a day.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: time

en:
Whether an entity type can be spawned in a world.
Any general types such as 'monster, mob, entity, living entity' etc. will never be spawnable.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is spawnable

is member/owner of region.name: is member/owner of region
patterns: %offline players% (is|are)(n't| not) ([a] member|[(the|an)] owner) of [[the] region] %regions%

en: Checks whether a player is a member or owner of a particular region.
This condition requires a supported regions plugin to be installed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is member/owner of region

is evenly divisible by.name: is evenly divisible by
patterns: %numbers% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) evenly divisible by %number% [with [a] tolerance [of] %number%]
%numbers% can be evenly divided by %number% [with [a] tolerance [of] %number%]

en:
Checks if a number is evenly divisible by another number.
An optional tolerance can be provided to counteract floating point error. The default tolerance is 1e-10.
Any input smaller than the tolerance is considered to be 0.
This means divisors that are too small will always return false, and dividends that are too small will always return true.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is evenly divisible by

en: Whether a location is within something else. The "something" can be a block, an entity, a chunk, a world, or a cuboid formed by two other locations.
Note that using the is between condition will refer to a straight line between locations, while this condition will refer to the cuboid between locations.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is within

en: Tests whether a player is allowed to build at a certain location.
This condition requires a supported regions plugin to be installed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: can build

en: Checks whether a location is contained in a particular region.
This condition requires a supported regions plugin to be installed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: region contains

en: Checks whether a world, chunk or script is loaded.
'chunk at 1, 1' uses chunk coordinates, which are location coords divided by 16.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is loaded

en: Checks whether an entity is sleeping.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is sleeping

en: Checks to see if an allay is able to duplicate naturally.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: allay can duplicate

equippable component - can be sheared of.name: equippable component - can be sheared off
patterns: %equippable components% can be sheared off [of entities]
%equippable components% (can't|cannot|can not) be sheared off [of entities]

en:
Whether an item can be sheared off of an entity.
NOTE: Equippable component elements are experimental. Thus, they are subject to change and may not work as intended.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: equippable component - can be sheared off

en: Checks whether a player is online. The 'connected' pattern will return false once this player leaves the server, even if they rejoin. Be aware that using the 'connected' pattern with a variable will not have this special behavior. Use the direct event-player or other non-variable expression for best results.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is online

en: Checks whether a potion effect has an icon.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: potion effect - has icon

en: Checks to see if an entity is currently using the Riptide enchantment.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is riptiding

en: Checks whether potion effects or timespans are infinite.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is infinite

en: Checks whether a player is a server operator.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: is operator

en: Checks whether the given players have a custom client weather

[(neither)] %objects% (was|were)[(n't| not| neither)] (less|smaller|lower|below) [than] or (equal to|the same as) %objects%

If the player is not moving when this effect is used, they will be put in sprint mode for a tick and then stopped (this causes the FOV to change). Using it a second time, without the player manually sprinting in between, causes the player to stay in sprint mode, with some quirks.
- Particles may not be produced under the player's feet.
- The player will not exit the sprinting state if they stop moving.
- Restrictions like low hunger will not prevent the player from sprinting
- The player pressing shift will stop them sprinting, and pressing sprint will re-assert normal sprinting behavior
Using this effect two or more consecutive times on a stationary player produces undefined behavior and should not be relied on.

en: Registers a new tag containing either items or entity datas. Note that items will NOT keep any information other than their type, so adding `diamond sword named "test"` to a tag is the same as adding `diamond sword`

Item tags should be used for contexts where the item is not placed down, while block tags should be used for contexts where the item is placed. For example, and item tag could be "skript:edible", while a block tag would be "skript:needs_water_above".

The URL must be a direct download link.
The hash is used for caching, the player won't have to re-download the resource pack that way.
The hash must be SHA-1, you can get SHA-1 hash of your resource pack using
this online tool.
The resource pack request action can be used to check
status of the sent resource pack request.

rotate.name: rotate
patterns: rotate %quaternions/displays% by x %number%, y %number%(, [and]| and) z %number%

en: Rotates displays, quaternions, or vectors around an axis a set amount of degrees, or around all 3 axes at once.
Vectors can only be rotated around the global X/Y/Z axes, or an arbitrary vector axis.
Quaternions are more flexible, allowing rotation around the global or local X/Y/Z axes, arbitrary vectors, or all 3 local axes at once.
Global axes are the ones in the Minecraft world. Local axes are relative to how the quaternion is already oriented.
Rotating a display is a shortcut for rotating its left rotation. If the right rotation needs to be modified, it should be acquired, rotated, and re-set.

Note that rotating a quaternion/display around a vector results in a rotation around the local vector, so results may not be what you expect. For example, rotating quaternions/displays around vector(1, 0, 0) is the same as rotating around the local X axis.

The same applies to rotations by all three axes at once. In addition, rotating around all three axes of a quaternion/display at once will rotate in ZYX order, meaning the Z rotation will be applied first and the X rotation last.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: rotate

If sending only the subtitle, it will only be shown if the audience currently has a title displayed. Otherwise, it will be shown when the audience is next shown a title.
Additionally, if no input is given for the times, the previous times of the last sent title will be used (or default values). Use the reset title effect to restore the default values for the times.

en: Plays a sound at given location for everyone or just for given players, or plays a sound to specified players. Both Minecraft sound names and Spigot sound names are supported. Playing resource pack sounds are supported too. The sound category is 'master' by default.
When running 1.19+, playing a sound from an entity directly will result in the sound coming from said entity, even while moving.
If the sound is custom, a location emitter will follow the entity. Do note that pitch and volume
are reflected based on the entity, and Minecraft may not use the values from this syntax.
Minecraft sometimes has a set of sounds under one sound ID that will randomly play. To counter this, you can directly state which seed to use.
Please note that sound names can get changed in any Minecraft or Spigot version, or even removed from Minecraft itself.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: play sound

en: Transforms (or 'maps') a list's values using a given expression. This is akin to looping over the list and setting each value to a modified version of itself.
Evaluates the given expression for each element in the list, replacing the original element with the expression's result.

If the given expression returns a single value, the indices of the list will not change. If the expression returns multiple values, then then indices will be reset as a single index cannot contain multiple values.
Only variable lists can be transformed with this effect. For other lists, see the transform expression.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: transform list

Providing a timespan only applies for piglins. It determines the length of time they will dance for. If no timespan is provided, they will dance indefinitely.

* Entity effects, which are particles or animations that are entity-specific and can only be played on a compatible entity. For example, the ravager attack animation can be played with this effect.

All effects vary significantly in availability from version to version, and some may simply not function on your version of Minecraft. Some effects, like the death animation entity effect, may cause client glitches and should be used carefully!

en: Rotates a quaternion or vector around an axis a set amount of degrees, or around all 3 axes at once.
Vectors can only be rotated around the global X/Y/Z axes, or an arbitrary vector axis.
Quaternions are more flexible, allowing rotation around the global or local X/Y/Z axes, arbitrary vectors, or all 3 local axes at once.
Global axes are the ones in the Minecraft world. Local axes are relative to how the quaternion is already oriented.

Note that rotating a quaternion around a vector results in a rotation around the local vector, so results may not be what you expect. For example, rotating around vector(1, 0, 0) is the same as rotating around the local X axis.

The same applies to rotations by all three axes at once. In addition, rotating around all three axes of a quaternion/display at once will rotate in ZYX order, meaning the Z rotation will be applied first and the X rotation last.

The area the particles will spawn in can be roughly estimated as being within 2 times the standard deviation in each axis. en: The block data an enderman is carrying.
Custom attributes such as NBT or names do not transfer over.
Blocks, blockdatas and items are acceptable objects to change the carrying block.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: enderman carrying blockdata

en: The amount of time the animals have been in love for. Using a value of 30 seconds is equivalent to using an item to breed them.
Only works on animals that can be bred and returns '0 seconds' for animals that can't be bred.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: love time

en: Returns or changes the text opacity of text displays. The default is 255, fully opaque. Values are between 0 and 255. 0 to 3 are treated the same as 255, meaning fully opaque. Values from 4 to 26 are fully transparent, and opacity increases linearly from there up to 255. For backwards compatability, setting negative values between -1 and -128 wrap around, so -1 is the same as 255 and -128 is the same as 128. Adding or subtracting values will adjust the opacity within the bounds of 0-255, so subtracting 300 wil always result in an opacity of 0.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: text display opacity

en: The player's progress in reaching the next level, this represents the experience bar in the game. Please note that this value is between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.5 = half experience bar).

Changing this value can cause the player's level to change if the resulting level progess is negative or larger than 1, e.g. increase the player's level progress by 0.5 will make the player gain a level if their progress was more than 50%.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: level progress

en: The players hidden from a player that were hidden using the entity visibility effect.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: hidden players

en: The cook time, total cook time, and burn time of a furnace. Can be changed.
<ul>
• cook time: The amount of time an item has been smelting for.
• total cook time: The amount of time required to finish smelting an item.
• burn time: The amount of time left for the current fuel until consumption of another fuel item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: furnace times

en: The center of a world border.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: center of world border

en: Gets or sets the length of a vector.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: vectors - length

en:
The entity type of a spawner (mob spawner).
Change the entity type, reset it (pig) or clear it (Minecraft 1.20.0+).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: spawner type

en: Spawns entities. This can be used as an effect and as a section.
If it is used as a section, the section is run before the entity is added to the world.
You can modify the entity in this section, using for example 'event-entity' or 'cow'.
Do note that other event values, such as 'player', won't work in this section.
If you're spawning a display and want it to be empty on initialization, like not having a block display be stone, set hidden config node 'spawn empty displays' to true.
Note that when spawning an entity via entity snapshots, the code within the section will not run instantaneously as compared to spawning normally (via 'a zombie').
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: spawn

en: The name of a player in the player list in the tab menu.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: player list name

en: The environment of a world
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: world environment

en: Returns the time that the entities have either spent using an item, or the time left for them to finish using an item.
If an entity is not using any item, this will return 0 seconds.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: active item use time

en: Returns the max duration an item can be used for before the action completes. E.g. it takes 1.6 seconds to drink a potion, or 1.4 seconds to load an unenchanted crossbow.
Some items, like bows and shields, do not have a limit to their use. They will return 1 hour.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: max item use time

en: Effectively an alias of 'y-coordinate of …', it represents the height of some location within the world.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: altitude

en: Returns or changes the brightness override of displays.
Unmodified displays will not have a brightness override value set. Resetting or deleting this value will remove the override.
Use the 'block' or 'sky' options to get/change specific values or get both values as a list by using neither option.

NOTE: setting only one of the sky/block light overrides of a display without an existing override will set both sky and block light to the given value. Make sure to set both block and sky levels to your desired values for the best results. Likewise, you can only clear the brightness override, you cannot clear/reset the sky/block values individually.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: display brightness

en: The yaw or pitch of a location or vector.
A yaw of 0 or 360 represents the positive z direction. Adding a positive number to the yaw of a player will rotate it clockwise.
A pitch of 90 represents the negative y direction, or downward facing. A pitch of -90 represents upward facing. Adding a positive number to the pitch will rotate the direction downwards.
Only Paper 1.19+ users may directly change the yaw/pitch of players.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: yaw / pitch

en: An item associated with an entity. For dropped item entities, it gets the item that was dropped.
For item frames, the item inside the frame is returned.
For throwable projectiles (snowballs, enderpearls etc.) or item displays, it gets the displayed item.

For arrows, it gets the item that will be picked up when retrieving the arrow. Note that setting the item may not change the displayed model, and that setting a spectral arrow to a non-spectral arrow or vice-versa will not affect the effects of the projectile.
Other entities do not have items associated with them.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: item of an entity

en: The item an entity is holding in their main or off hand.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: tool

en: The flower a beehive has selected to pollinate from.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: beehive target flower

en: The last block or entity that attacked an entity.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: last attacker

en: Returns the looted entity of a loot context.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: looted entity of loot context

en: The difficulty of a world.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: difficulty

en: Returns or changes the alignment setting of text displays.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: text display alignment

en:
The entities allowed to wear the item.
NOTE: Equippable component elements are experimental. Thus, they are subject to change and may not work as intended.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: equippable component - allowed entities

en: The author of a book.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: book author

en: Get an exact item representation of a block, carrying over any data. For example, using this expression on a chest block with items stored inside will return a chest item with the exact same items in its inventory as the chest block.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: exact item

en: Obtains the block's hardness level (also known as "strength"). This number is used to calculate the time required to break each block.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: block hardness

en: Pings of players, as Minecraft server knows them. Note that they will almost certainly be different from the ones you'd get from using ICMP echo requests. This expression is only supported on some server software (PaperSpigot).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: ping

en: An expression to obtain the duration of a potion effect.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: potion effect - duration

en: The maximum health of an entity, e.g. 10 for a player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: max health

en: Power of a redstone block
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: redstone block power

en: Get an entity, player, offline player or world from a UUID.
Unloaded entities or players that are offline (when using 'player from %uuid%') will return nothing.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: entity/player/world from uuid

en: Represents the physical size/scale of something.
For example, the scale of a display entity would be a vector containing multipliers on its size in the x, y, and z axis.
For a particle effect like the sweeping edge particle, scale is a number determining how large the particle should be.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: scale

en: The exhaustion of a player. This is mainly used to determine the rate of hunger depletion.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: exhaustion

en: Returns the luck of a loot context as a float. This represents the luck potion effect that an entity can have.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: luck of loot context

en: Rounds numbers normally, up (ceiling) or down (floor) respectively.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: rounding

en: The facing of an entity or block, i.e. exactly north, south, east, west, up or down (unlike direction which is the exact direction, e.g. '0.5 south and 0.7 east')
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: facing

en: The range of a beacon's effects, in blocks.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: beacon range

en: Returns the last resource pack response received from a player.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: last resource pack response

en: Returns the loot location of a loot context.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: loot location of loot context

en: Sets how many particles to draw. Particle count has an influence on how the 'offset' and 'extra' values of a particle apply. Offsets are treated as distributions if particle count is greater than 0. Offsets are treated as velocity or some other special behavior if particle count is 0. This means that setting the particle count may change how your particle behaves. Be careful! More detailed information on particle behavior can be found at Paper's particle documentation.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: particle count

en: Returns the looter of a loot context. Note that setting the looter will read the looter's tool enchantments (e.g. looting) when generating loot.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: looter of loot context

en:
The equippable component of an item. Any changes made to the equippable component will be present on the item.
NOTE: Equippable component elements are experimental. Thus, they are subject to change and may not work as intended.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: equippable component

en: Returns the entity snapshot of a provided entity, which includes all the data associated with it (name, health, attributes, etc.) at the time this expression is used.
Individual attributes of a snapshot cannot be modified or retrieved.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: entity snapshot

en: Scoreboard tags are simple list of texts stored directly in the data of an entity.
So this is a Minecraft related thing, not Bukkit, so the tags will not get removed when the server stops. You can visit visit Minecraft Wiki for more info.
This is changeable and valid for any type of entity. Also you can use use the Has Scoreboard Tag condition to check whether an entity has the given tags.
Requires Minecraft 1.11+ (actually added in 1.9 to the game, but added in 1.11 to Spigot).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: scoreboard tags

en: The view distance of the client. Can not be changed. This differs from the server side view distance of player as this will retrieve the view distance the player has set on their client.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: view distance of client

en: Grabs the spectator target entity of the players.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: spectator target

en: Humidity of given blocks.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: humidity

en: Returns the current cooldown for a player's attack. This is used to calculate damage, with 1.0 representing a fully charged attack and 0.0 representing a non-charged attack.
NOTE: Currently this can not be set to anything.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: attack cooldown

en: The damage value/durability of an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: damage value/durability

en: Gets a skull item representing a player. Skulls for other entities are provided by the aliases.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: player skull

en: The current number of entities stored inside an entity block storage (i.e. beehive).
The maximum amount of entities an entity block storage can hold.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: entity storage entity count

en: Returns the middle/center of a location. In other words, returns the middle of the X, Z coordinates and the floor value of the Y coordinate of a location.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: middle of location

en: Retrieve specific information of a timespan such as hours/minutes/etc.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: timespan details

en: Index of an an inventory slot. Other types of slots may or may not have indices. Note that comparing slots with numbers is also possible; if index of slot is same as the number, comparisonsucceeds. This expression is mainly for the cases where you must for some reason save the slot numbers.
Raw index of slot is unique for the view, see Minecraft Wiki
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: slot index

en: The total experience, in points, of players or experience orbs.
Adding to a player's experience will trigger Mending, but setting their experience will not.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: total experience

en: The causing entity of a damage source.
The causing entity is the entity that ultimately caused the damage. (e.g. the entity that shot an arrow)
When setting a 'causing entity' you must also set a 'direct entity'.
Attributes of a damage source cannot be changed once created, only while within the 'custom damage source' section.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: damage source - causing entity

en: Gets the value within objects. Usually used with variables to get the value they store rather than the variable itself, or with lists to get the values of a type.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: value within

en: Returns the location offset by vectors. Supports both global and local axes. When using local axes, the vector is applied relative to the direction the location is facing.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: vectors - location vector offset

en: Metadata is a way to store temporary data on entities, blocks and more that disappears after a server restart.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: metadata

potion effect of entity/item.name: potion effect of entity/item
patterns: [the] [active|hidden|(active and hidden|hidden and active)] %potion effect types% [potion] effect[s] of %living entities/item types%
%living entities/item types%'[s] [active|hidden|(active and hidden|hidden and active)] %potion effect types% [potion] effect[s]

en: An expression to obtain a specific potion effect type of an entity or item.

When an entity is affected by a potion effect but already has a weaker version of that effect type, the weaker version becomes hidden. If the weaker version has a longer duration, it returns after the stronger version expires.
NOTE: Hidden effects are not able to be changed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: potion effect of entity/item

en: Returns a node inside a config (or another section-node).
Nodes in Skript configs are written in the format `key: value`.
Section nodes can contain other nodes.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: node

en: Returns a copy of an item with with new lore.
If passing multiple components, each with be a line of lore.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: item with lore

en: Returns the lore of an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: lore

en: Converts date to human-readable text format. By default, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss z' (e.g. '2018-03-30 16:03:12 +01') will be used. For reference, see this Wikipedia article.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: formatted date

banner patterns.name: banner patterns
patterns: [all [[of] the]|the] banner pattern[s] of %item stacks/item types/slots/blocks%

en: Gets or sets the banner patterns of a banner.
In order to set a specific position of a banner, there needs to be that many patterns already on the banner.
This expression will add filler patterns to the banner to allow the specified position to be set.
For Example, setting the 3rd banner pattern of a banner that has no patterns on it, will internally add 3 base patterns, allowing the 3rd banner pattern to be set.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: banner patterns

en: All items or specific type(s) of items in an inventory. Useful for looping or storing in a list variable.
Please note that the positions of the items in the inventory are not saved, only their order is preserved.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: items in

en: A line of text on a sign. Can be changed, but note that there is a 16 character limit per line.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: sign text

en: The pages of a book (Supports Skript's chat format)
Note: In order to modify the pages of a new written book, you must have the title and author
of the book set. Skript will do this for you, but if you want your own, please set those values.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: book pages

en: Directly names an item/inventory, useful for defining a named item/inventory in a script. If you want to (re)name existing items/inventories you can either use this expression or use set name of <item/inventory> to <text>.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: named item/inventory

en: Counts how many of a particular item type are in a given inventory.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: amount of items

en: Equipment of living entities, i.e. the boots, leggings, chestplate or helmet.
Body armor is a special slot that can only be used for:
<ul>
• Horses: Horse armour (doesn't work on zombie or skeleton horses)
• Wolves: Wolf Armor
• Llamas (regular or trader): Carpet
• Happy Ghasts: Harness
Saddle is a special slot that can only be used for: pigs, striders and horse types (horse, camel, llama, mule, donkey).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: armor slot

en: Returns the value of something that has a value, e.g. a node in a config.
The value is automatically converted to the specified type (e.g. text, number) where possible.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: value

en: Get an item with custom model data.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: item with custom model data

en: The level of a particular enchantment on an item.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: enchantment level

en: The first, last, range or a random element of a set, e.g. a list variable, or a queue.
Asking for elements from a queue will also remove them from the queue, see the new queue expression for more information.
See also: random expression
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: elements

en: For players this is the entity at the crosshair.
For mobs and experience orbs this is the entity they are attacking/following (if any).
The 'ray size' and 'ignoring blocks' options are only valid for players' targets.

The 'ray size' option effectively increases the area around the crosshair an entity can be in. It does so by expanding the hitboxes of entities by the given amount. Display entities have a hit box of 0, so using the 'ray size' option can be helpful when targeting them.
May grab entities in unloaded chunks.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: target

en: Returns the value of an sub-node of the given node, following the provided path.
The value is automatically converted to the specified type (e.g. text, number) where possible.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: value of subnode

en:
Provides access to the 'persistent data container' Bukkit provides on many objects. These values are stored on the chunk/world/item/entity directly, like custom NBT, but are much faster and reliable to access.
Persistent values natively support numbers and text, but any Skript type that can be saved in a variable can also be stored in PDC via this expression. Lists of objects can also be saved.
If you attempt to save invalid types, runtime errors will be thrown.

The names of tags must be valid namespaced keys, i.e. a-z, 0-9, '_', '.', '/', and '-' are the allowed characters. If no namespace is provided, it will default to 'minecraft'.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: persistent data value

en: The biome at a certain location. Please note that biomes are only defined for x/z-columns
(i.e. the altitude (y-coordinate) doesn't matter), up until Minecraft 1.15.x.
As of Minecraft 1.16, biomes are now 3D (per block vs column).
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: biome

en: Gets the light level at a certain location which ranges from 0 to 15.
It can be separated into sunlight (15 = direct sunlight, 1-14 = indirect) and block light (torches, glowstone, etc.). The total light level of a block is the maximum of the two different light types.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: light level

en: All regions at a particular location.
This expression requires a supported regions plugin to be installed.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: regions at

en: The entity involved in an event (an entity is a player, a creature or an inanimate object like ignited TNT, a dropped item or an arrow).
You can use the specific type of the entity that's involved in the event, e.g. in a 'death of a creeper' event you can use 'the creeper' instead of 'the entity'.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: creature/entity/player/projectile/villager/powered creeper/etc.

en: A shorthand for returning the result of a condition (true or false). This is functionally identical to using `true if <condition> else false`.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: whether

en: Reduces lists to single values by repeatedly applying an operation.
The reduce expression takes each element and combines it with an accumulator value.
Use 'reduced value' to access the current accumulated value and 'input' for the current element.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: reduce

en: Transforms (or 'maps') a list's values using a given expression. This is akin to looping over the list and getting a modified version of each value.

If the given expression returns a single value, the indices of the list will not change. If the expression returns multiple values, then then indices will be reset as a single index cannot contain multiple values.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: transformed list

en: Returns a list of all the values of a type. Useful for looping.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: sets

en: Returns an 'or list' composed of the given objects. For example, `any of (1, 2, and 3)` is equivalent to `1, 2, or 3`
Useful when doing comparisons with variable lists.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: any of

en: Arithmetic expressions, e.g. 1 + 2, (health of player - 2) / 3, etc.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: arithmetic

en: An expression for using an item or entity type with a different amount.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: x of item/entity type

en: Parses text as a given type, or as a given pattern.
This expression can be used in two different ways: One which parses the entire text as a single instance of a type, e.g. as a number, and one that parses the text according to a pattern.
If the given text could not be parsed, this expression will return nothing and the parse error will be set if some information is available.
Some notes about parsing with a pattern:
- The pattern must be a Skript pattern, e.g. percent signs are used to define where to parse which types, e.g. put a %number% or %items% in the pattern if you expect a number or some items there.
- You have to save the expression's value in a list variable, e.g. set {parsed::*} to message parsed as "...".

- The list variable will contain the parsed values from all %types% in the pattern in order. If a type was plural, e.g. %items%, the variable's value at the respective index will be a list variable, e.g. the values will be stored in {parsed::1::*}, not {parsed::1}.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: parse

[(all [[of] the]|the)] entities of type[s] %entity types% within %location% and %location%

en: All entities in all worlds, in a specific world, in a chunk, in a radius around a certain location or within two locations. e.g. all players, all creepers in the player's world, or players in radius 100 of the player.

en: Create a loot context.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: create loot context

en: Rounds a number down, i.e. returns the closest integer smaller than or equal to the argument.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: floor

en: Get the factorial of a number.
Getting the factorial of any number above 21 will return an approximation, not an exact value.
Any number after 170 will always return Infinity.
Should not be used to calculate permutations or combinations manually.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: factorial

en: Joins the provided texts (and other things) into a single text.
description.ko: Skript 공식 코어 구문입니다: concat

en: The inverse of the sine, also called arcsin. Returns result in degrees, not radians. Only returns values from -90 to 90.

en: Get the number of possible ordered arrangements from 1 to 'options' with each arrangement having a size equal to 'selected'
For example, permutations with 3 options and an arrangement size of 1, returns 3: (1), (2), (3)
Permutations with 3 options and an arrangement size of 2 returns 6: (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 1), (2, 3), (3, 1), (3, 2)
Note that the bigger the 'options' and lower the 'selected' may result in approximations or even infinity values.
Permutations differ from combinations in that permutations account for the arrangement of elements within the set, whereas combinations focus on unique sets and ignore the order of elements.
Example: (1, 2) and (2, 1) are two distinct permutations because the positions of '1' and '2' are different, but they represent a single combination since order doesn't matter in combinations.

en: Loop sections repeat their code with multiple values.

A loop will loop through all elements of the given expression, e.g. all players, worlds, items, etc. The conditions & effects inside the loop will be executed for every of those elements, which can be accessed with ‘loop-’, e.g. send "hello" to loop-player. When a condition inside a loop is not fulfilled the loop will start over with the next element of the loop. You can however use stop loop to exit the loop completely and resume code execution after the end of the loop.
Loopable Values

All expressions that represent more than one value, e.g. ‘all players’, ‘worlds’, etc., as well as list variables, can be looped. You can also use a list of expressions, e.g. loop the victim and the attacker, to execute the same code for only a few values.
List Variables

When looping list variables, you can also use loop-index in addition to loop-value inside the loop. loop-value is the value of the currently looped variable, and loop-index is the last part of the variable's name (the part where the list variable has its asterisk *).
